init.title: GoodWe Local Server
init.description: Packets are always decoded locally first. Relaying is best effort: if GoodWe's server can't be reached, local sensors keep working.

data.relay_replies: Pass GoodWe's replies back to devices

data_description.relay: Forward every packet to tcp.goodwe-power.com so the SEMS portal keeps receiving data.
data_description.relay_replies: Lets GoodWe send time sync and remote firmware updates to devices. Leave off unless needed.
